title: Zrythm Clipboard Payload
description: Schema for Zrythm clipboard payloads (UNSTABLE - v2.alpha under active development). A clipboard payload is a self-contained snapshot of copied arranger objects, tracks or plugins. It mirrors the project file's registry format: flat buckets containing every object reachable from the copied roots, the root UUIDs, and free-form per-type metadata. The text form put on the OS clipboard is this JSON document, zstd-compressed and base64-encoded, prefixed with 'ZRYTHM-CLIPBOARD:v1:'.

formatVersion.description: Clipboard format version (bumped on incompatible changes)

payloadType.description: Which kind of objects the roots are

sourceProjectId.description: Persistent identity of the source project (Project::projectId, regenerated on Save As). Used at paste time to decide whether references to objects outside the payload still resolve

metadata.description: Free-form per-payload-type paste context (anchor position, lane indices, plugin group category, source slot indices, track routing, folder nesting)

anchorTicks.description: Timeline/content position of the earliest root object; the pasted selection is anchored at the playhead with this offset. Bounded to reject hostile magnitudes

laneIndices.description: Lane index per root clip UUID (lane-preserving paste)

groupCategory.description: Which plugin group category the plugins were copied from

sourceIndices.description: Source slot/tracklist index per root UUID

routing.description: Output routing of the copied track roots: an entry per routed root. The target may point outside the payload (e.g. the master track) and is then kept as-is for same-project paste or cleared cross-project

folderParents.description: Folder nesting of the copied roots: child root UUID to parent root UUID (both part of the payload)

registry.description: Every object reachable from the roots, in the same bucket format as the project file's registry

roots.description: UUIDs of the copied objects (entry points of the payload)
